text: 【第二批全国零售业创新提升试点城市发布】近日，商务部等4部门公布第二批全国零售业创新提升试点城市名单。商务部表示，试点城市要统筹用好现代商贸流通体系建设试点、一刻钟便民生活圈建设、城市更新行动、大规模设备更新、服务消费与养老再贷款、地方招商引资等政策，持续优化经营环境。同时，还要在政策创新、管理创新、模式创新等方面大胆探索，加快构建供给丰富、布局均衡、渠道多元、服务优质、智慧便捷、绿色低碳的现代零售体系。
text_en: 【第二批全国零售业创新提升试点城市发布】Recently, four departments including the Ministry of Commerce released the list for the second batch of national pilot cities for retail industry innovation and upgrading. The MOFCOM stated that pilot cities should coordinate and utilize policies such as modern commercial circulation system pilots, 15-minute convenience living circles, urban renewal actions, large-scale equipment updates, service consumption and elderly care re-lending, and local investment promotion, to continuously optimize the business environment. They should also boldly explore policy, management, and model innovations to accelerate building a modern retail system that is supply-rich, evenly distributed, multi-channel, high-quality, smart and convenient, and green and low-carbon.
